title: Smallest Missing Integer Greater Than Sequential Prefix Sum
summary: Given an array of integers, find the smallest integer x not present in the array that is at least as large as the sum of the longest sequential prefix of the array.
statement: Given an array of integers, find the smallest integer x not present in the array that is at least as large as the sum of the longest sequential prefix of the array.
constraints: Start with the longest prefix whose adjacent values increase by exactly one.
Sum every value in that sequential prefix.
Return the smallest integer no less than that sum which does not occur anywhere in nums.
reference_solution:
def smallest_missing_after_sequential_prefix(nums):
    total=nums[0]
    for i in range(1,len(nums)):
        if nums[i]!=nums[i-1]+1:break
        total+=nums[i]
    present=set(nums)
    while total in present:total+=1
    return total
